title.narrative: Norec, FK Norway, post exchange initiative

description.narrative: The program combines productive asset transfers, skills training, mentorship, social protection, and financial inclusion to help ultra-poor households (living on less than $1.90/day) sustainably graduate from poverty. Market Circles is inspired by proven models such as BRAC and Village Enterprise but tailored to local market community realities. The goal is to enable these ladies to increase their household income by 30-40% within 6 months and sustain income above $1.90/day by month 12 through our 4B model. Within 6 months, we expect all 25 women to complete foundational business training covering planning, financial literacy, and record-keeping. Each participant will receive productive assets worth up to $100 and establish active businesses, with 100% participating in savings groups. We anticipate achieving a 30-40% average household income increase from baseline. To monitor progress, we'll conduct bi-weekly mentorship sessions and quarterly business check-ins using our Business Health Scorecard, while tracking income through household diaries and quarterly PPI surveys.
